title: Free steel profile (source)
description: Woodcore-Datei/profiles/<id>.json -- one free steel profile drawn or typed in Woodcore's «Profilés» tab: rectangles, each with the role of its wall in the section class (issue #50, spec 2026-10-12-section-acier D-10, D-11, D-12; docs/domain/steel.md). Read and checked by calc/domains/profile.py (`check_source`), which computes its values; a position names it by the section type USR and the id as its dimension. Every length in mm.

id.description: The file's name; never an SZS C5 designation («HEA 200»), which a position's dimension would read as a catalogue profile.

group.description: The folder of the tab's left pane.

template.description: The model the profile was drawn from -- {kind: I | U | T | L | RHS | plate, params} or {c5: "HEA 200", kind, params} -- kept as provenance, never read back as a value.

y.description: The lower left corner, to the right.

role.description: internal: a plate held on both long edges (Tabelle 5a); outstand: held on one (Tabelle 5b); none: a junction, not classified. domains/profile.py ROLES.
